mapper.update: UPDATE t_work_order SET status = 'ACCEPTED', assignee_id = #{repairerId}, dispatch_type = 'GRAB', assign_time = NOW(), accept_time = NOW(), version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND deleted = 0 AND assignee_id IS NULL AND status = 'CREATED'
UPDATE t_work_order SET assignee_id = NULL, assign_time = NULL, dispatch_type = NULL, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE t_work_order SET priority = #{priority}, expect_hours = #{expectHours}, deadline_time = #{deadlineTime}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND deleted = 0 AND arrive_time IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED')
UPDATE t_work_order SET timeout_flag = 1, timeout_type = #{timeoutType}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND deleted = 0
